name: Ireland
title: Ireland: government scholarships for international postgraduates
lede: Ireland is English-speaking, research-intensive and part of the EU. Its government funds international postgraduates through the GOI-IES scholarships and, for researchers, Research Ireland's postgraduate awards.
description: Funded postgraduate study in Ireland for international students: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships, Research Ireland awards, proof of funds and work rules.
card: GOI-IES pays €10,000 plus a fee waiver; Research Ireland has funded research degrees — check the 2027 call.

sections.html:
• Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships: 60 awards a year, each with a €10,000 stipend and a full fee waiver for one year of master's or PhD study, for students domiciled outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK. The 2026 call closed on 12 March.
  • Research Ireland postgraduate scholarships: a €25,000 stipend plus fees and research costs for research master's and PhD students of any nationality. No 2027 call had been announced when we last checked.

sections.h: Proof of funds and fees for your visa
sections.html: Students from visa-required countries must show access to at least €10,000 for living costs for each year of study. Since 30 June 2025 you must also have paid at least €6,000 of your tuition (or the full fee if it is lower) before a visa is granted. A scholarship covering these costs usually counts — keep your award letter ready.

Non-EU students with Stamp 2 permission can work up to 20 hours a week during term and up to 40 hours a week in the holidays (June to September, and 15 December to 15 January). Hours cannot be averaged across weeks.
